teaching.hint: What must stay true about the stored members so that every one has the same chance of being selected after insertions and removals?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: A hash index and dense value array support complementary operations; replacing a removed element with the last preserves density.
solution_outline.approach: Keep an array of current values and a map from value to array index. Insert by appending; remove by moving the final value into the removed slot; sample a uniform array index.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: The array contains each set member exactly once and the map points to its current position.
solution_outline.correctness: Each update preserves the bijection. A uniform index selects each of the equally represented members with identical probability.
solution_outline.complexity: Average O(1) time per operation and O(s) auxiliary space for s stored values.
solution_outline.pitfall: Removing an interior array entry by shifting later entries costs linear time.

common_wrong_turns: Choose randomly from hash-table iteration order
source_fidelity_notes: The average-time and equal-probability requirements are retained.
